# Perform linear regression analysis for education expenditure vs GNI per capita
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# Prepare the data for regression
X_gni = education_expenditure.values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor
y_gni = gni_per_capita.values  # Response

# Create a linear regression model
model_gni = LinearRegression()
model_gni.fit(X_gni, y_gni)

# Get the coefficient and p-value
coefficient_gni = model_gni.coef_[0]
p_value_gni = model_gni.score(X_gni, y_gni)

# Perform linear regression analysis for education expenditure vs school enrollment (primary)
